about_the_game:
In a wartorn world of wrath and riches, the tyrannical King of Light manipulated the Calame – a transcendent magic that transforms beliefs into truth – and made himself a god. After years of violence and oppression, his power is all but absolute.

It is up to you to harness the forbidden power of the Calame to rebel against the King of Light and weave the threads of destiny. Rewrite history to twist the elements of the battlefield to your advantage. Fight alongside a diverse roster of 15 heroes, each unique personalities, and alter their stories and abilities. Author your own legend with a narrative campaign filled with epic combat encounters and rich storylines.

Will you rise as the people's champion or use the Calame to enforce your will?
You decide how the story ends.


This demo offers a limited content in terms of features, story lines and quests compared with what will appear in the full game. Check what’s included or not in the current version of the demo.

This demo includes:

  • The first 4 chapters of the game (out of 25 + bonuses)

  • Up to 5 playable characters (out of 15)

  • A limited number of skills and perks

  • The possibility to replay already-completed chapters

This demo does NOT include:

  • The Camp where all your companions have a rest between battles. You will be able to talk to each character to get to know them and create specific bonds with them

  • The weapon upgrade from the Black-Smith from the Camp

  • The item and spell shops from the Camp

  • The possibility to evolve your character into a new archetype

  • The alignment (Good or Bad) and consequences

  • The Game Codex with all info you will progessively unlock about the lore, character stories, etc.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 2060 6 GB / AMD Radeon RX 5700 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD required. Minimum specs allow for 1080p 30FPS low settings gameplay.
